title: CryptoPulse Binance BTCUSDT Aggregated Trade
description: Schema for normalized Binance BTCUSDT aggTrade events produced by the CryptoPulse collector.

event_time.description: Binance event timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

event_time_utc.description: Same Binance event timestamp represented as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

price.description: Trade price as provided by Binance and preserved as a string by the collector.

quantity.description: Aggregated trade quantity as provided by Binance and preserved as a string by the collector.

first_trade_id.description: First individual trade ID included in the aggregate trade.

last_trade_id.description: Last individual trade ID included in the aggregate trade.

trade_time.description: Binance trade timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

buyer_is_maker.description: Indicates whether the buyer was the market maker.
